name: confirm_live_identity
description: Unlock approved returning-user memory only after Amy has completed a useful warm exchange, asked for the preferred name and email separately, repeated the email spelling, and received explicit confirmation. After success, follow the returned instruction: briefly identify two or three distinctive earlier-session facts, distinguish them from today's statements, and ask whether they are still current.

email.description: The exact email spelling the visitor explicitly confirmed during this live conversation.
